scenes.big: Quiz: how close is too close?
scenes.say: Quick quiz. When your child plays games, how close is too close?

scenes.en: Tablet or phone: at least 30–40 cm away. TV: sit well back.
scenes.ta: டேப்லெட் 30-40 செ.மீ தூரம்; டிவியை தள்ளி இருந்து பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: The answer. Keep a tablet or phone at least thirty to forty centimetres away, and sit well back from the TV.

scenes.en: Close focus for hours tires the eye's focusing muscle. Gamers blink less too.
scenes.ta: நீண்ட நேரம் அருகில் பார்த்தால் கண் சோர்வடையும்
scenes.say: Why? Focusing up close for hours keeps the eye's focusing muscle working hard, and gamers blink less. That means tired, dry eyes and headaches.

scenes.en: Daily outdoor play in daylight helps lower the risk of short sight.
scenes.ta: தினமும் வெளியே விளையாடுவது கிட்டப்பார்வை அபாயத்தை குறைக்கும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show daily outdoor play in daylight helps lower the risk of short sight in children.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
scenes.say: Use the twenty twenty twenty rule. Every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away for twenty seconds.

scenes.big: Swap a level for a ride
scenes.en: Set a daily screen limit. No screens an hour before bed.
scenes.say: Set a daily screen limit, switch screens off an hour before bed, and swap one game for a cycle ride.

scenes.en: Squinting, eye rubbing, headaches, sitting too close.
scenes.ta: கண் சுருக்குதல், தேய்த்தல், தலைவலி இருந்தால் கவனியுங்கள்
scenes.say: Watch for squinting, eye rubbing, headaches, or sitting too close. Book an eye test for your child today.
